summary: ansible.utils now requires netaddr 0.10.1+ and ansible-core 2.14+. It handles netaddr 1.0.0 removing IPAddress.is_private() in favor of an extended is_global(), which affects the ipaddr filter.
questions: What netaddr version does ansible.utils need?
Why did the ipaddr private filter behavior change?

answer_card.title: ansible.utils and netaddr 1.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- Requires `netaddr>=0.10.1` and ansible-core 2.14+.
- netaddr 1.0.0 removed `IPAddress.is_private()` and extended `is_global()` to cover it. The `ipaddr` filter plugin was updated to match.
